# 2014 AERIAL ASSIST – hindsight

Source: user hindsight notes, batch 1 (2026-09-27).

## Game play / meta
- Elite game play had **three roles**: the first robot catches from the first human player and passes back to him; the
  second receives from the human player and passes over the truss to the second human player; the third catches from
  the second human player and shoots into the goal, aligned close in, or from distance if a defender blocked it.
  Robots with spare time played defense until they needed to fill their offensive role.
- In AUTO, a single robot shooting all 3 balls into the high goal was effective.

## Dominant robots
- **254** – the best and most dominant robot of the season; the only elite robot that thought of shooting these large
  balls with a **wheeled shooter with a hood**. Had two intakes, to allow 3 balls in AUTO.

## Effective mechanisms
- **1114 blocker pole** – used in AUTO to block robots from scoring.
- **1114 / 118 / 971 utility arm** (in the author's view 1114's was the best) – a pivoting arm that both intakes from the
  ground with wheels and rotates to shoot/pass with wheels or a puncher.
- **1678 / 33** catapult.
- **33 antennas** – to make catching balls from the air easier (although catching did not become the meta).
- **469 / 1577 motorized catapult** – not the best, but very simple.
- **254 / 1678** double intakes.
